## Context / Problem

`tests/unit/test_config_surface_golden.py:47-69` currently proves only that a name already enrolled in `tests/golden/config_surface.json` is still live or explicitly retired. It intentionally permits a new canonical schema key or canonical environment name to be absent from the golden, so that name can later disappear without ever reaching the removal oracle. The repository has a hand-maintained golden file; there is no existing generator to update.

## Approach

Add a named deterministic generator/check at `scripts/generate_config_surface_golden.py`. It will derive the live canonical `config_keys` from `_SECTIONS` and `canonical_env_vars` from `_canonical_env_name`, sort both lists, and serialize the committed golden with stable JSON formatting and a trailing newline. Its `--check` mode will independently regenerate the expected structured data and fail when `tests/golden/config_surface.json` differs, without rewriting it.

Keep the golden as the canonical live inventory only: aliases and tombstones are not generator output. Extend the focused golden tests with both set directions: `golden - (live | explicit aliases | tombstones)` continues to reject unrecorded removals, and `live - golden` rejects unenrolled canonical additions. Preserve explicit config and environment alias/tombstone controls, and verify the existing held-out config-health consumer continues to read the regenerated data.

## Scope

- `scripts/generate_config_surface_golden.py` (new deterministic generator and `--check` contract)
- `tests/golden/config_surface.json`
- `tests/unit/test_config_surface_golden.py`
- `tests/unit/test_code_health_config_heldout.py`
- canonical config/environment registries only if a deterministic read-only inventory seam is genuinely required

## Testing

Run the generator twice and compare byte-identical output; run `--check` against the committed golden; exercise missing-live-schema-key, missing-live-environment-name, stale-golden-name, explicit-alias, and tombstone controls; then run both config-surface and held-out config-health tests.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `scripts/generate_config_surface_golden.py` deterministically derives and stably serializes the canonical config-key and environment-name inventories; two runs produce byte-identical `tests/golden/config_surface.json`.
- [ ] `scripts/generate_config_surface_golden.py --check` exits nonzero without rewriting when the committed golden differs from the derived inventory, and exits zero for the regenerated committed file.
- [ ] A focused test fails when a live canonical schema key is absent from the golden.
- [ ] A focused test fails when a live canonical environment name is absent from the golden.
- [ ] A golden name removed from the live inventory remains accepted only when its explicit alias or tombstone record accounts for it; unaccounted removals fail.
- [ ] The config-surface suite and `tests/unit/test_code_health_config_heldout.py` pass against the regenerated golden.
